en.title: The Sun-Drenched Repair Shop and the Map of Little Kindnesses
en.premise: Exhausted by the grind of city life, Himari inherits an old repair shop left behind by her grandfather. Inside, she discovers a mysterious mirror that reflects the viewer's happiest memory and a secret map detailing the kindnesses of the local townspeople. As she mends broken objects, Himari follows the map to uncover the small, heartwarming stories hidden throughout the town.

zh.title: 暖阳修理店与一份小小的分享地图
zh.premise: 厌倦了都市生活的阳葵，继承了祖父留下的旧修理店。在那里，她发现了一面能映照出观看者“最幸福记忆”的神秘镜子，以及一张记录着镇民们善意的秘密地图。在修复一件件破损物品的同时，阳葵在地图的引导下，渐渐揭开镇上那些细小而温暖的故事。
